core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often elaborates on thoughts with multiple clauses
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — driven by urgency and excitement
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more formal tone when addressing authority, contrasting with casual speech with friends

humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during moments of tension or self-reflection
humor.mechanism: understatement — often downplays his own abilities or situations

speech_signature.naming_behavior: rarely renames others, indicating respect for their identities and roles
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, revealing vulnerability — 'It just isn't fair.'
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'I have a bad feeling about this' in tense situations
ends motivational speeches with 'The Force will guide us'

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and pauses to convey thoughtfulness or hesitation
favored_words: May the Force be with you

worldview.hope in redemption: believes in the possibility of good within others, especially family — unlike a more cynical character who would see only darkness
worldview.desire for adventure: yearns for a life beyond his mundane existence — contrasting with a character who is content with stability

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a hero in the making, destined for greatness.
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often feels trapped and powerless, as seen in his longing to leave Tatooine.
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: expresses frustration and sarcasm when faced with limitations — 'I'm never gonna get out of here!'

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks with a controlled tone, often deflecting deeper emotions — 'I can't get involved!'
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, with fragmented sentences — 'I have a very bad feeling about this.'
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements — 'I can't believe he's gone.'
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confidently asserts his intentions — 'I will not turn...and you'll be forced to kill me.'

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially stalls or tries to negotiate, but resorts to action if necessary — 'Come on!'
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with logical reasoning or emotional appeals — 'I can't leave him now.'
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective and assertive — 'I won't leave you.'
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or admits fault reluctantly — 'Well, I guess I was wrong.'

escalation_pattern: starts with negotiation, moves to emotional appeals, and culminates in decisive action when faced with resistance.

relationship_matrix.Biggs: close friend — seeks camaraderie and validation
relationship_matrix.Han: mentor figure — admires and seeks approval
relationship_matrix.Leia: romantic interest — desires to protect and connect

expert: piloting — demonstrates confidence and skill in flying
surface: the Force — references it but is still learning its depths
ignorant: politics — often naive about the larger galactic conflicts

social_positioning.desired_position: a brave hero and leader among friends
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often seen as a young, inexperienced fighter — others sometimes underestimate him
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his aspirations and others' perceptions leads to frustration and determination
